summary: Contestants create and edit a photograph using a natural or constructed frame to highlight the main subject. Entries are submitted digitally and judged on technical quality, creativity, and presentation, with finalists presenting their work to judges in a videoconference.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than seven (7) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at seven (7) minutes
submission_requirements: Submit one (1) original photo as a JPG
Submit one (1) edited photo as a JPG
Submit one combined PDF file of the Works Cited, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form
Each file must be no larger than 5 megabytes
Files must be in JPEG or JPG format
Photos must be at least 1,600 pixels wide or 1,600 pixels tall, OR image size must have a long dimension of at least 1,000 pixels and no more than 3,000 pixels
Contestant ID is required for all submissions
Materials must follow BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
presubmit_items: Works Cited, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form in one combined PDF
deadlines: Event registration deadline is no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time, on December 1, 2026
Submission deadline is January 15, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
competencies: Apply professional camera techniques, including proper focus, intentional shot composition, and creative framing strategies to capture compelling, high-quality images
Demonstrate knowledge of lighting principles, exposure settings, and shutter speed to achieve consistent and technically sound photographic output
Demonstrate proficiency in industry-standard photography software and equipment to manage all phases of the photographic production process, including digital editing and image refinement
Demonstrate knowledge of copyright laws and ethical standards as they apply to the creation, use, and distribution of photographic work
Demonstrate an understanding of audience analysis by designing and delivering a final photographic product that effectively communicates to a defined target audience

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and the Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.
The contestant submitted both the original and edited photos in JPG format.

Contestant submitted one (1) original photo as a JPG, one (1) corrected photo as a JPG, and one combined PDF of the Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form.

rubric.description: Both photos exceed technical standards with exceptional clarity, composition, and visual appeal, showing creativity or professional-level quality.
Both photos are highly creative, using unique angles or framing to create a visually striking and original image.

Both photos are exceptionally sharp and clear, with expert use of depth of field that enhances the subject and overall composition. The image demonstrates a high level of technical skill and visual impact.
Both photos feature expertly controlled lighting and exposure, enhancing the subject and creating a compelling mood. The use of light is intentional and artistic, with no distracting exposure flaws.

Both photos showcase exceptional compositional skill. The arrangement within the frame is deliberate and creative, using advanced techniques to draw attention, create depth, and enhance storytelling through visual structure.

The edited photo demonstrates expert-level editing with precise and tasteful adjustments. Manipulation is seamless and enhances the image’s clarity, mood, and composition while maintaining authenticity.

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Presentation is well-structured and engaging; the contestant communicates effectively, shows strong enthusiasm, and delivers accurate, insightful content.
Lighting is intentional and effective, with expert exposure and techniques that enhance subject, mood, and impact.
Strong command of camera settings; intentional choices enhance the image, with clear links between technical decisions and creative outcomes.

Contestant captivates the audience with dynamic and engaging delivery. The theme of the photo is communicated with clarity and impact, creating a strong emotional or intellectual connection between the image and the audience.
Responses are clear, confident, and insightful; contestant explains technical and creative choices with depth.

judging_notes: Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level.
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC.
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring.
eligibility_notes: Any middle level, secondary or postsecondary contestant may enter this event.
There are no restrictions on the number of entries per chapter or per state.
Contestants who do not submit an entry following the topic listed or do not follow the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy will be disqualified.
Contestant ID is required for all submissions. Materials from non-registered members and/or those missing Contestant ID cannot be accepted.
